func (r *userRepository) GetByID(ctx context.Context, id int64) (*model.User, error) {
	var m model.User

}

func (r *userRepository) List(ctx context.Context, page int, pageSize int) ([]*model.User, int64, error) {

		return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("page and pageSize must be positive and offset must fit int")

	var total int64

		return nil, 0, err
	}
	var items []*model.User
	offset := (page - 1) * pageSize
	err := r.db.WithContext(ctx).Order("`id`").Offset(offset).Limit(pageSize).Find(&items).Error
	return items, total, err
}
